authorization: Current user requests stagewise backup; existing HH create-only dual-provider backup authorization retained. Parent owns final path/hash approval; no extra user confirmation required for this authorized scope.
pre_upload_gate: Parent supplies finalized absolute path, exact bytes and SHA256.
Confirm source path exists and retain archive validation already performed.
Use final basename; if prior same-name object is found, compare known identity and reuse if matching or create a distinct suffix without overwriting.
No outgoing upload initiated by this preparation task.

schema.source_file: absolute local path string; runtime fileParams adapter handles object injection

providers.parent_verified: 450-entry direct root list complete; PHYS71/PHYS70 archives are in this root
providers.no_overwrite: ALREADY_EXISTS must not be retried against the same path
providers.post_upload: Retain exact returned file_id/path_display/size/modified_time/status; metadata read on returned id. Byte verification may reuse actual downloaded data if required; do not invent a provider SHA.

schema.file_uri: absolute local path string accepted by surfaced runtime file adapter

providers.parent_verified: Current get_file_metadata returned folder MIME; PR123 L64 result and GIT bundle returned this exact parent.
providers.no_overwrite: upload_file creates a new object; never update/delete existing objects. Same-name Drive objects can coexist; use unique final basename or reconcile prior attempt before retry.
providers.post_upload: Retain returned id/URL/status; read exact returned metadata. Requested checksum fields may be omitted by adapter; only claim what was returned.
providers.historical_failure_separation: Old PHYS70 Drive upload UNKNOWN_UNRESOLVED remains independent; this is a new PHYS72 object.

providers.destination: Library root (directory_id omitted), matching prior PHYS71 source archive location
providers.route_condition: Exactly one local final archive under about50MiB. For multiple Library files or archive>=about50MiB use current library_upload.py with whole ordered batch; never switch an already-started unknown-outcome helper write to direct write.
providers.metadata_writeback: In same functions.exec invocation as successful create, pass complete returned xattrs array or [] to current library_file_transfer.py apply-xattrs LOCAL_PATH LIBRARY_FILE_ID via stdin JSON; inspect result.
providers.current_limitations: Read materialization helper failed current tool-list network thenHTTP403. Upload route has not been probed because finalized file was not supplied; do not infer upload failure.

read_only_destination_checks.absence_limit: Drive filters already missed known L64 objects, so empty search does not prove absence. Keep source/hash identity and reconcile unknown outcomes before any retry.

receipt_separation: The immutable source archive can contain this plan; actual later provider ACKs belong in external delivery receipt and Git metadata commit, without rewriting archive or making self-referential hash claims.
